section_header: SUSPENSION AND AXLE — REAR DRIVE SHAFT
ocr_text:
SA–51

SUSPENSION AND AXLE – REAR DRIVE SHAFT

Grease capacity (Inboard joint):
    100–105 g (0.22–0.23 lb, 3.5–3.7 oz.)
HINT: Use the grease supplied in the boot kit.
NOTICE:
• Keep grease off the joint connection groove of the boot.
• Pack with grease all over the ball contact surface inside the joint.

6. INSTALL NEW BOOT CLAMPS TO BOTH BOOTS
(a) Position the clamp onto the boot.
HINT: Pinch the inboard side of the boot clamp, as shown in the illustration.
(b) Place SST onto the clamp.
SST 09521–24010

30°
SST

(c) Tighten SST so that the clamp is pinched.
NOTICE: Do not overtighten the SST.

SST

(d) Using SST, adjust the clearance of the clamp.
SST 09240–00020
Clearance:
    0.8 mm (0.031 in.) or less

0.8 mm (0.031 in.)
or less

SST

(e) The drive shaft is designed to move +20 mm from the normal position.
